title: Backend solution of consistent sample equations
statement: Let $n,\ell,m$ be natural numbers, choose $m$ samples in $\{0,1\}^n\times\mathbb F_2$, and let a linear solver backend return a degree-at-most-$\ell$ coefficient family. If some such coefficient family satisfies every sample equation, then the family returned by the backend also satisfies every sample equation.
hypotheses_covered: The sample equations have a satisfying degree-at-most-$\ell$ coefficient family
